description: Use when someone asks how their brand shows up in AI, or how to show up. Takes a brand name or website. Returns the brand's public standing from Parse's index (where AI names it, in which markets, with the data's date) and one link to sign up. Reads only data Parse already holds. Next: parse_get_brand with the returned slug for the questions and sources behind it.

brand.description: The brand's name or website, for example acme.com.

name: parse_check_brand
title: Check how AI sees a brand
